messages.message: Austria here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks home centers in 1901. Austria and Italy keep Adriatic/Balkan lines calm; Austria will look to Serbia and Greece, not Italy. Happy to hear proposals from all.

England here. I'm looking for peace on my borders and would like to stay non-aggressive with you both. France, shall we keep the Channel quiet? Germany, I'll stay out of the North Sea corner if you stay out of Holland and Belgium on my side. Happy to coordinate.

Italy and Austria: Tunis and Greece are open; let's keep it peaceful in the Med. Happy to hear counteroffers.

Germany here. I propose a peaceful opening: no one attacks anyone in 1901. Germany will stay defensive in the center and north, and will not move into Holland or Denmark aggressively. Open to coordinating against whoever grows fastest, likely Russia. Reply if you want to talk.

Russia here. I propose peace: no one attacks anyone's home centers in 1901. Turkey and I can both focus on neutral centers (SEV/RUM/SWE/NWY/BUL/GRE). Germany, France, England: let's coordinate so no one gets run over early. Happy to hear proposals.

Turkey here. Proposal: no early aggression between Turkey and anyone who isn't Russia. Russia, you hold WAR/MOS/SEV/STP and I'd like to keep the Black Sea and Balkans calm. Let's aim for a Balkan split: I take BUL and GRE over time, and I'll stay out of Rumania and Serbia if Austria and Russia keep off Constantinople and Smyrna. Open to a non-aggression pact with Russia; reply and we'll talk specifics.

Proposal: Austria and Italy both keep out of each other's home centers; Italy takes TUN, Austria takes SER.

England here. I'm taking Norway this year with fleets; I'd like you to stay out of it and not push on Sweden at my expense. In return I won't threaten STP. Open to coordinating against whoever grows too fast.

France: agreed on peace in 1901. I'll take Spain (A MAR-SPA) and Belgium (F BRE-PIC or PAR-BEL route) and leave Holland/Denmark to Germany. England, Channel stays quiet from my side. Let's all aim for neutral centers and avoid home-center attacks this year.
